Thus CD_dC and C*D_eC are Hilbert–Schmidt. The Cesàro weakly null harmonic packets give essential norm 2; its commutator C*C-CC* is Hilbert–Schmidt, so its Calkin image a is normal. With b=pi(D_c), aba=ma² and a*b*ba=mu a*a imply (ba)^p=m^(p-1)ba^p and ||ba^p||=sqrt(mu)2^p. The zero-mean square-zero and numerical-radius conclusions follow by C*-algebra calculus, with p=1 interpreted separately at m=0. A finite independent check tested periodic cancellation entrywise for multiple patterns; the proof is infinite-dimensional.
